QuestInfo.name: Talking to Stan
QuestInfo.1: At the entrance of #m10001000#, I met #p402#'s father, #p202#, the chief of Henesys. He wouldn't let me even start a conversation about Alex with him, and he demanded I bring him #b15 #t4000013#s#k and #b15 #t4000016#s#k if I want to talk to him.
QuestInfo.2: Only after I brought the #t4000013#s and #t4000016#s did #p202# start talking to me.

0.0: You want to talk to me? I'm the elder of this town--I don't have time to waste chatting with someone like you. If you really want a word with me, bring something the town could use. Hunt #r25 #o13#s#k and #r25 #o16#s#k, and collect #b15 #t4000013#s#k and #b15 #t4000016#s#k. Maybe then I'll have a moment to spare.

1.0:
Who are you? I don't think we've met.

#b#L0# I'm just a traveler. Don't mind me.
#L1# I'm here on #p402#'s behalf. Just give me five minutes.
#L2# Haha... Isn't it beautiful today?#l
1.1:
#p402#? Ha, I no longer have a son with that name. Get out of here!

#b#L0# Ah... Yes, sir. Sorry for bothering you.
#L1# But #p402# wants to come home.
#L2# Cut it out! #p402# is sorry for running away!#l
1.2:
Eh? Confronting me now? Yelling at me in public? Hmm, you must be somebody important. Fine. How's #p402# doing?

#b#L0# #p402# is having a hard time since he ran away.
#L1# #p402# is getting sick of wandering around.
#L2# Why don't you ask #p402# yourself?#l
1.3:
Ask him myself? Hahahaha! I like you. That makes me wonder. What do YOU think of ME?

#b#L0# I think you are a great chief.
#b#L1# I think you are too harsh on Alex.
#b#L2# I think you hide the fact that you're actually a warm person.#l
1.4:
Yes, like you said, I'm the chief, but ever since #p402# left, I've been losing face!

#b#L0# #p402# knows he made poor decisions, but he's asking for forgiveness. What he needs right now is a compassionate father.
#b#L1# Do you care about your image in this town than your son? You've got to be kidding me!
#b#L2# #p402#'s been unsettled since his mother passed away. Your strict nature hasn't helped him any. How about forgiving him?#l
1.5: You know THAT much? I suppose it's true that #p402# has been more rebellious since Anna passed away. I've been busy with my chiefly duties, and perhaps I've neglected him. Maybe this is my fault...\n\n#b#L0# If you truly believe that, you should try to reconcile with him.#l
1.6: Thank you. Thanks to you, I think I can finally clear up the misunderstanding with #p402#. Please tell him he's welcome to return to the town. Of course, I'll still be taking the materials I asked for earlier. Oh, and one more thing... This is my #t4031006#, a keepsake of his mother Anna. Please give it to him. He'll understand what it means. Here, take it.

0.0: What do you think I am, a tourist attraction? Shame on you... and get out of my face.
0.2: Ah yes, such a beautiful day... or not! I have no time for idle chit chat. Scram!

1.0: What a chicken. You tell me you know #p402# and then want to flee when I get angry? I don't even want to speak to you. Get out of here.
1.1: He wants to come home? Hahaha...! That's a lie! I'm sure he's happy that he can do whatever he wants now, especially since he took my money.

2.0: He's having a hard time? Good! Please give him this message: #bStay away. Feel the pain. Experience the hard life! Then maybe you'll learn a thing or two about being independent.#k
2.1: Sick of it?! He wants to come home now that he's sick of living alone? Hahahahahaha! As of this moment, I know no #p402#! What an ungrateful... Argh.

3.1: You are brutally honest. I usually like honesty, but I don't appreciate your candor one bit right now. Are you trying to make me mad?
3.2: Hahaha! You're either very observant, or you're a kiss-up. Either way, it doesn't matter. I'm busy. Scram.

4.0: You don't know #p402# like I do. What were you offered in return for helping #p402#? It doesn't matter, I can never forgive him. Please leave...
4.1: Maybe, maybe not! But I have responsibilities! I've served as chief of this town longer than you've been alive. Who are you to chastise ME?

item.0: You want to talk to me? I am the chief of this town; I don't have the time to sit around and chat with someone like you. If you really want to talk to me, bring me some materials to repair the town. I might be able to spare some time if you can hunt #b#e25#n#k #b#o13#s#k and #b#e25#n #o16#s#k, and bring me #b15 #t4000013#s#k and #b15 #t4000016#s#k...
